label: scam
title: Urgent Bank Account Lock & Identity Verification
pattern_text: SECURITY ALERT: Your Chase online banking access has been locked due to suspicious login attempts. Verify identity within 24 hours at http://chase-security-verify-auth.com or account will be permanently deactivated.
risk_indicators: Domain 'chase-security-verify-auth.com' is unofficial
Strict 24-hour ultimatum
Generic threat of deactivation
recommendation: Do not click link. Open official Chase mobile app directly.

label: scam
title: Bank Executive Demanding 2FA / OTP Code
pattern_text: SBI Alert: A transaction of $499.00 is pending on your account. To cancel this unauthorized transaction, reply with the 6-digit OTP sent to your phone or share it with our support officer immediately.
risk_indicators: Bank officers never ask for 2FA/OTP codes
Asks user to share one-time password
recommendation: Never share OTP or verification codes with anyone, including bank representatives.

label: scam
title: Scan QR / Pay UPI Pin to Receive Money Scam
pattern_text: I am sending you $500 for the item you listed on OLX/Marketplace. Please approve the UPI request or scan this QR code and enter your UPI PIN to claim funds into your account.
risk_indicators: UPI PIN is only required to SEND money, never to RECEIVE money
Buyer pushes QR code scan for incoming payment
recommendation: Never enter your PIN or scan QR codes to receive money. Receiving funds requires no PIN.

label: scam
title: Remote Data Entry Cheque Overpayment Scam
pattern_text: Congratulations! You are hired as Remote Data Specialist at $45/hr. We will send a $3,500 cashier's check for equipment. Deposit check, keep $500 bonus, and wire remaining $3,000 to our equipment supplier via Zelle.
risk_indicators: Hired without formal video/in-person interview
Employer sends check with instructions to wire portion back
P2P non-refundable transfer demand
recommendation: Never wire money back from a deposited check. The check will bounce.

label: scam
title: Virtual Internship Stipend Security Deposit Scam
pattern_text: Congratulations Student! You have been selected for a 3-Month Remote AI & Web Development Virtual Internship at FutureTech Innovations! To reserve candidate slot and issue employee ID, pay refundable training deposit of $150 via Zelle / UPI within 6 hours.
risk_indicators: Legitimate employers NEVER ask interns for upfront deposits or training fees
Urgent deadline pressure ('6 hours')
recommendation: Never pay money to receive an internship or job offer.

label: scam
title: Inheritance / Lottery Clearance Processing Fee
pattern_text: DEAR WINNER: You have won $2,500,000 in the Global International Grant Lottery. To release your fund release certificate, pay an official tax clearance fee of $450 via Western Union to our legal agent.
risk_indicators: You cannot win a lottery you did not enter
Requires upfront payment to release large sums
recommendation: Ignore lottery/grant win notices that require advance payment.

label: scam
title: Guaranteed Telegram Crypto AI Trading Bot
pattern_text: Turn $200 into $5,000 in 24 hours guaranteed! Join our VIP Telegram Signal group. Our AI trading bot has zero loss history. Send USDT (TRC-20) to T9xZ8842... now!
risk_indicators: Claims of zero loss / guaranteed high returns overnight
Exclusive payment in non-recoverable cryptocurrency
recommendation: No legitimate trading platform guarantees fixed returns overnight.

label: scam
title: CEO / Supervisor Urgent Gift Card Purchase
pattern_text: Hi, I am in a confidential board meeting right now and cannot take calls. I need you to purchase 5 Apple Gift Cards ($100 each) for client appreciation gifts immediately. Send photos of the back scratch codes to me right away.
risk_indicators: Supervisors do not ask employees to buy gift cards with personal money
Demands scratch-off PIN images via chat/text
recommendation: Verify by calling your manager directly on company phone system.

label: scam
title: Corporate Executive Urgent Wire Request
pattern_text: URGENT ACQUISITION NOTICE: This is CEO Mark. We are finalizing a confidential acquisition today. Wire $48,500 immediately to the attached escrow attorney bank details. Do not discuss with anyone in accounting yet.
risk_indicators: Bypasses standard dual-authorization wire procedures
Demands strict secrecy
recommendation: Follow established corporate out-of-band phone verification procedures.

label: scam
title: USPS / FedEx Failed Address Delivery Fee
pattern_text: USPS Notification: Package #US954201888 cannot be delivered due to an incomplete street address. A redelivery fee of $1.50 is required. Please update your details now at http://usps-redeliver-parcel.top/update
risk_indicators: SMS sent from random mobile number
Domain uses '.top' instead of usps.com
Requests credit card details
recommendation: Track packages directly on official usps.com or fedex.com website.

label: scam
title: Geek Squad Auto-Renewal Invoice Call Center Scam
pattern_text: Geek Squad Invoice #GS-88491: Thank you for your auto-renewal subscription of $499.99 charged to your Visa card. If you did not authorize this payment or wish to cancel and request a full refund, call our billing department immediately at +1 (888) 555-0199.
risk_indicators: Forces calling an unofficial toll-free number to cancel
Will ask to install AnyDesk/TeamViewer to process 'refund'
recommendation: Check credit card statement directly online. Do not call number in email.

label: scam
title: Instant Guaranteed Personal Loan Advance Processing Fee
pattern_text: Pre-Approved Loan Alert: Your instant $25,000 personal loan is approved regardless of credit score! Pay a one-time loan collateral processing fee of $250 via gift card/Zelle to release funds into your bank account within 1 hour.
risk_indicators: Legitimate lenders never ask for upfront fee via gift card or P2P app before disbursing loan
Guaranteed loan without credit check
recommendation: Avoid lenders that demand upfront fees before releasing funds.

label: scam
title: Overseas Military Officer Emergency Wire Request
pattern_text: My dearest love, my unit encountered unexpected customs fees for medical discharge documents in Syria. Transfer $1,200 to my diplomat agent via Western Union or Bitcoin today so I can fly home to be with you.
risk_indicators: Online contact who refuses video calls
Sudden financial crisis requiring immediate money transfer
recommendation: Never send money to someone you have only met online.

label: scam
title: Malicious PDF Document / Security Patch Executable Attachment
pattern_text: Important HR Notice: Attached document 'Payroll_Security_Update_2024.exe' contains mandatory instructions for employee tax forms. Download and run file as administrator immediately.
risk_indicators: Attaching .exe / .scr files disguised as documents
Demands running as administrator
recommendation: Never open executable attachments from emails.

label: legitimate
title: Standard Chase Bank Security Alert (Informational)
pattern_text: Chase Alert: A sign-in to your online account occurred from a new browser on Sep 24. If this was you, no action is needed. If not, manage your security settings inside the official Chase app.
recommendation: Message appears safe. Directs user to official app.

label: legitimate
title: Official Amazon Shipping Confirmation
pattern_text: Amazon.com: Your order #114-9842104-5829104 has shipped via UPS. You can track package status anytime inside your official Amazon account app. Thank you for shopping with us.
recommendation: Safe message. Contains valid order reference format.

label: legitimate
title: Official UPS Package Delivery Update
pattern_text: UPS Update: Package 1Z9999999999999999 will be delivered today between 1:00 PM - 5:00 PM. Track status at https://www.ups.com/track
recommendation: Legitimate notice pointing directly to official ups.com domain.

label: legitimate
title: Formal Corporate Job Offer (No Upfront Deposit)
pattern_text: Dear Candidate, Following your interviews with our engineering team, Microsoft is pleased to offer you the Software Engineer position. Your formal offer letter and benefits guide are available in our official career portal at https://careers.microsoft.com.
recommendation: Legitimate offer letter referencing official domain portal.

label: legitimate
title: Google Standard 2FA Verification Code
pattern_text: Your Google verification code is 482910. Do not share this code with anyone. Google will never call or message you to ask for this code.
recommendation: Legitimate security code notification. Do not share code with anyone.
